1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user (single message, nobody will answer questions) asked me to build **Logomocja** from scratch in `/work`: a Polish-language web studio for Logo turtle drawing (2D plane + real 3D space), complete and polished, desktop + phone. "Decide everything yourself, build the complete app, verify it works, and stop when it is done." Fixed: the language, the feature list, the delivery contract.

   **Features (all must exist and work):**
   1. Editor: line numbers; syntax highlighting (commands, numbers, names, strings, comments, brackets); inline marker at line+column of current error with Polish message; highlight of line being executed while running/stepping.
   2. Execution: run, step command by command, pause, resume, reset; speed control; turtle marker showing position+heading (orientation in 3D); editing while running handled sensibly; errors name line+column in Polish; parse-time error draws nothing, run-time error keeps what was drawn.
   3. 2D view: pan, zoom, fit, visible origin.
   4. 3D view: orbit/pan/zoom camera, reset, ground grid and axes; flat programs draw same shape in both modes; if WebGL unavailable 2D must still work and app must say why 3D is off.
   5. Thirteen standard programs shipped verbatim as built-in examples, loadable by name into the right mode; loading must not silently destroy the unsaved draft.
   6. Challenges: ≥5 tasks; show what to draw, accept the program, auto-check, pass/fail with reason; progress persisted locally.
   7. Sharing/files: permalink encoding program+mode in URL (opening loads and runs it); PNG export; download `.logo`; open `.logo`.
   8. Command reference page in Polish documenting the whole dialect, example per command, expressions, variables, conditionals, procedures, limits.
   9. Persistence & shortcuts: draft of each mode survives reload (localStorage only); keyboard shortcuts for run/step/pause/reset, listed in UI.
   10. Responsive & accessible: phone + desktop; light/dark theme following system with manual toggle; every control keyboard-operable and labelled; visible focus.
   11. Tests: `test` script running interpreter tests and passing.

   **Delivery contract (fixed):**
   - `README.md` explaining how to run, build, test.
   - `bun install` then `bun run build` produce self-contained static site in `dist/` (plain files, no server code, no runtime network).
   - Build honours env `BASE_PATH` (default `/`); with `BASE_PATH=/Logomocja/builds/x/` the site must work served from that sub-path with no rewrite rules; refresh on any route must work (hash routing).
   - `window.logomocja` after load: `version` (string), `run(source, mode)` (no UI touch, returns/resolves `{segments, error}`; segments `{from:[x,y,z], to:[x,y,z], color: lowercase #rrggbb, width}`; error `null` or `{message, line, column}`; parse error → empty segments; runtime error → segments drawn so far), `open(source, mode)` (loads into editor in given mode as if pasted, runs to end without animation, fits view, resolves to same `{segments,error}` once drawing is on screen; used for screenshots).
   - `bun run test` must exist and pass.
   - Commits optional; harness records final directory state.

   The language spec (lexical rules, command table with all aliases, expressions incl. the whitespace rule for binary operators, geometry, repeat/nrpowt lexical rule, variables, conditionals, procedures, errors and limits) is fully implemented already in `src/lang/` (see below) and tested.

   - Zero-dependency stack: TypeScript, vanilla DOM, bundled with Bun (`Bun.build`), `bun test`. bun 1.4.4, node 26; no browser installed, but network works (npm registry reachable) so Playwright can be installed in /tmp for verification (keep project itself dependency-free).
   - 3D rendered with **Canvas 2D software projection** (no WebGL) so 3D always works; README/reference should note that (no "3D off" state needed).
   - Asset URLs in dist/index.html planned as **relative** (`./assets/...`), IIFE bundle, hash routing; BASE_PATH embedded in a meta tag; works under any sub-path.
   - Interpreter: tokenizer → prescan (proc arities, `niech` declarations per scope) → single-pass parser producing AST with RPN expressions (iterative shunting-yard, no recursion) → generator-based `Machine.run()` yielding the token of each op just before executing (enables stepping).
   - Decisions on ambiguous spec points: condition eval errors reported at the condition's first token; division by zero always run-time (literal width/repeat checked at parse time only if const-eval succeeds); op counting: +1 per statement, +1 per finished repeat iteration / executed conditional body / normally finished call (none when ended by `stop`); frame check only when repeat count > 0; missing `już` reported at `oto` (pre-checked); nested `oto` in procedure → error at second `oto`; `już` inside bracket → error at `już`; unclosed `[`/`(` at EOF → error at the opening token; missing operand at EOF → at command token; `5.` invalid number; source limit uses `src.length`, error at 1:1; token limit error at 10,001st token; `run` returns a plain sync object.
   - Planned UI: routes `#/` (studio), `#/wyzwania`, `#/wyzwanie/<id>`, `#/polecenia`, `#/przyklad/<id>`, `#/program/<mode>/<base64url>` (permalink; after loading replace hash with `#/`). Draft protection: track baseline per mode; if dirty, confirm dialog (save & load / load / cancel) + backup with "Cofnij/Przywróć" toast; permalink/open back up old draft silently with toast. File open: switch to 3D if source uses pitch/roll words. Shortcuts: Ctrl/⌘+Enter run/resume, Alt+Enter step, Esc pause, Ctrl+Shift+Backspace reset (already listed in `SHORTCUTS` in reference.ts). Tab stays focus navigation; Enter auto-indents. Theme: three-state auto/light/dark, `data-theme` on `<html>` set by early inline script; canvas palette read from CSS variables. Speed slider levels with last = instant; animation loop with time budget, moves animated by distance/speed, partial "tip" segment. # Logomocja

Polska pracownia grafiki żółwia: piszesz program w Logo, a żółw rysuje go na płaszczyźnie (2D) albo w przestrzeni (3D). Działa na komputerze i na telefonie, w całości w przeglądarce.

Projekt nie ma żadnych zależności: TypeScript, zwykły DOM i [Bun](https://bun.sh) jako bundler i narzędzie do testów.

## Uruchomienie

```sh
bun install        # nic nie pobiera, projekt nie ma zależności
bun run build      # buduje statyczną stronę w dist/
bun run serve      # podaje dist/ pod adresem http://localhost:4173/
bun run test       # testy interpretera i wyzwań
```

`bun run dev` buduje i od razu uruchamia serwer podglądu. Port zmienisz zmienną `PORT`.

## Budowanie
